title: BharatPIILabelSchema
description: Formal JSON Schema for Indian PII entity annotations, character offset conventions, and IOB2 sequence representation.

pii_categories.description: Full or partial names of individuals in Indian contexts across regional naming conventions, patronymics, and honorifics.
Indian Permanent Account Number issued by the Income Tax Department (10-character alphanumeric: 5 uppercase letters, 4 digits, 1 letter).
12-digit Indian unique identification number issued by UIDAI, validated via Verhoeff checksum algorithm.
Indian telephone and mobile numbers (10 digits, optionally prefixed with +91 or 0, with or without standard spacing/hyphens).
Electronic mail addresses following standard RFC 5322 syntax.
Unified Payments Interface virtual payment address (VPA) in handle@psp or phone@psp syntax.
Indian commercial bank account numbers (9 to 18 digits).
Indian physical residential and commercial delivery addresses comprising building, street/road, locality, city/state, and 6-digit PIN code.
examples: Flat 230, Silver Oak Heights, Baner Road, Bengaluru 754235

span_convention.offset_type: Python native string slice character offsets
span_convention.script_compatibility: Native Unicode code point indexing compatible across Latin, Devanagari, and Indic scripts.
